parameter_pack.description: Synthetic single-phase water-loop parameters for software demonstrations only. These are not NVIDIA or Vertiv specifications. Replace this pack on the unresolved project input and rerun for vendor/calibrated data. Explicit mock two-mixed-volume HX interpretation; not NV measurements or calibrated vendor performance.

primary_circuits.source_reference: Synthetic default adopted at Prepare/export: 1 kg/s primary inlet at 293.15 K, 0.02 m3 on each HX side; primary fluid cp/rho follow the saved project fluid. Not measured or calibrated vendor data.
